정리하다.m: to organize, to tidy up; to sum up
정리하다.x: I neatly organized my desk over the weekend.

갈아입다.x: Change into comfortable clothes before you work out.
갈아입다.t: Pattern: 옷으로 갈아입다 = change into clothes; same 갈아- as 갈아타다 'to transfer'.

충전.x: My phone got fully charged overnight.

잘못하다.m: to do wrong, to make a mistake
잘못하다.x: I treated my younger sibling badly, so I apologized first.
잘못하다.t: Pronounced [잘모타다]; 잘못했어요 'I was wrong' is the standard sincere apology.

막다.m: to block, to stop; to prevent
막다.ex: 큰 차가 길을 막고 있어서 지나갈 수 없어요.
막다.x: A big truck is blocking the road, so we can't get through.
막다.e: Its passive 막히다 gives 길이 막히다 'traffic is jammed'.

홍수.ex: 비가 일주일 동안 내려서 홍수가 났어요.
홍수.x: It rained for a week, and there was a flood.
홍수.t: Disasters 'happen' with 나다: 홍수가 나다, 지진이 나다, 불이 나다.

바람직하다.x: Exercising every day is a desirable habit.
바람직하다.e: From 바라다 'to wish': literally 'worth wishing for'.

확산.ex: 감기 확산을 막으려면 손을 자주 씻으세요.
확산.x: To stop colds from spreading, wash your hands often.
확산.t: Pronounced [확싼] — ㅅ after ㄱ becomes tense.

보편적.x: Loving your family is a universal feeling.

조화롭다.ex: 이 마을은 자연과 건물이 조화롭게 어울려요.
조화롭다.x: In this village, the buildings blend harmoniously with nature.

(이)라도.forms: 이라도 after a consonant (물이라도) · 라도 after a vowel (커피라도) · 누구라도, 언제라도 (any-)
(이)라도.m: even if it's just, at least (second-best choice); any- (누구라도 anyone)
(이)라도.x: If you're hungry, do you want to eat at least some ramyeon?
(이)라도.e: From 이다 'to be' + -라도 'even if' — 'even if it is (only) X'.
(이)라도.t: Shows X isn't ideal but will do. It softens offers and suggestions: 차라도 한잔할까요? 'Shall we at least have some tea?'

상품권.x: I got a department store gift card as a birthday present.
상품권.e: Literally 'merchandise ticket'; -권 = ticket: 상품권, 입장권, 승차권.
상품권.t: Pronounced [상품꿘]. Very popular as a holiday gift in Korea.

방치하다.m: to leave alone, to neglect, to leave unattended
방치하다.ex: 고장 난 자전거가 몇 달째 길에 방치되어 있어요.
방치하다.x: A broken bike has been left abandoned on the street for months.

곁들이다.m: to serve with, to add on the side, to accompany
곁들이다.x: I had the steak with a salad on the side.
곁들이다.e: 곁 'side' + 들이다 'to bring in': bringing something in on the side.

밀어붙이다.m: to push ahead (with), force through; to push (something) against
밀어붙이다.x: There was a lot of opposition, but the mayor pushed the plan through.
밀어붙이다.e: 밀다 'to push' + 붙이다 'to stick': pushing until it sticks.
밀어붙이다.t: Pronounced [미러부치다]: ㅌ before 이 becomes ㅊ (palatalization).

동기 부여.ex: 칭찬은 학생들에게 큰 동기 부여가 됩니다.
동기 부여.x: Praise is a big motivator for students.
동기 부여.t: Say 동기 부여가 되다 for 'to get motivated' and 동기를 부여하다 for 'to motivate someone'.

방임.ex: 아이를 돌보지 않고 방임하는 것도 일종의 학대입니다.
방임.x: Neglecting a child without caring for them is also a form of abuse.
방임.t: 아동 방임 is the standard term for child neglect in news and law.

약효.x: This medicine starts working after 30 minutes.
약효.t: Common phrases: 약효가 나타나다 (kick in), 약효가 떨어지다 (wear off).

역설하다.m: to emphasize strongly, to stress, to insist
역설하다.x: The prime minister stressed the need for education reform.
역설하다.t: Homonym warning: 역설 (逆說) means paradox; as a verb, 역설하다 usually means 'to stress'.

급기야.m: in the end, finally (after things got worse)
급기야.ex: 두 사람은 계속 다투다가 급기야 헤어지고 말았어요.
급기야.x: The two kept fighting and in the end broke up.
급기야.e: From a Classical Chinese phrase, roughly 'when it finally came to that'.
급기야.t: Usually introduces a dramatic or negative result, often with -고 말다.

어림잡아.m: roughly, approximately, at a rough estimate
어림잡아.ex: 오늘 온 손님은 어림잡아 백 명쯤 돼요.
어림잡아.x: There were roughly a hundred guests today.
어림잡아.e: From 어림 'rough estimate' + 잡다 'to take': taking a guess.

입지.m: standing, position; location, site (for a building or business)
입지.ex: 이번 성공으로 그의 입지가 더욱 탄탄해졌어요.
입지.x: This success made his position even more secure.
입지.e: Literally 'standing ground' — the spot you stand on.
입지.t: Pronounced [입찌]; 입지가 좁아지다 means 'to lose ground, to be squeezed out'.

평화 유지군.ex: 유엔은 분쟁 지역에 평화 유지군을 파견했습니다.
평화 유지군.x: The UN dispatched peacekeeping forces to the conflict zone.

버팀목.m: prop, support beam; mainstay, pillar of support
버팀목.ex: 힘든 시기에 가족이 제 버팀목이 되어 주었어요.
버팀목.x: My family was my pillar of support during hard times.
버팀목.e: From 버티다 'to hold out' + 목 'wood': a wooden prop that holds something up.
버팀목.t: Often said of a person or industry: 수출은 한국 경제의 버팀목이다, 'exports are the mainstay of Korea's economy.'

성서.ex: 성서는 세계에서 가장 많이 번역된 책이에요.
성서.x: The Bible is the most translated book in the world.
성서.t: In daily speech 성경 is more common; 성서 sounds more formal or academic.

고분벽화.ex: 고구려 고분벽화에는 사냥하는 모습이 그려져 있어요.
고분벽화.x: Goguryeo tomb murals depict scenes of hunting.

태산북두.m: a leading authority, a towering figure in a field
태산북두.x: He was revered as the towering authority in Korean linguistics.
태산북두.e: Literally 'Mount Tai and the Big Dipper' — things everyone looks up to.
태산북두.t: Pronounced [태산북뚜]; a highly respectful, formal expression.
